description: The left dock switches to a vertical surface 108px wide, with four icons ordered top to bottom.

assertions.comment: The left dock requests a vertical surface with calculated width 108px and output height 768px
The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) is 8px from the left edge for the Floating margin
The vertical panel is centered at y=274, which is (768-220)/2
The left vertical panel width is 64px: a 48px icon plus 16px of left and right padding
The left vertical panel height is 220px, including four items, spacing, and padding
The calculated left-edge position for the unnamed panel path is 8px
Left dock icons have increasing y coordinates from top to bottom
The vertical dock’s DockItem width is 56px, including the icon and launch indicator space
The vertical dock’s DockItem height is 48px, equal to IconSize
